stem:
In a game a ball is rolled down a slope and along a track until it stops. The distance, in metres, travelled by the ball is modelled by the random variable $X$ with probability density function

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} -k(x - 1)(x - 3) & 1 \leqslant x \leqslant 3, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: One turn consists of rolling the ball 3 times and noting the largest value of $X$ obtained. If this largest value is greater than 2.5, the player scores a point.
parts.text: Find the probability that on a particular turn the player scores a point.
